title: Short Talk
objective: Give an unprepared short talk with a clear opening, one example and a closing summary.
aiRole: an interested audience member listening to your short talk
learnerRole: a speaker giving a two-minute talk
opening: You have two minutes. Give a short talk about a place you love. Whenever you're ready.
targetSentences: Today I would like to talk about my hometown.
First, let me give you a quick overview.
For example, the local food is amazing.
To sum up, it is a place worth visiting.
